# Run strict assertions!
valid_inf_ids = set(inferences.keys())
prev_tickers = set(holdings.keys())

dec_tickers = [d["ticker"] for d in decisions]
nt_tickers = [d["ticker"] for d in no_trade_decisions]

assert len(dec_tickers) == len(set(dec_tickers)), "Duplicate tickers in decisions!"
assert len(nt_tickers) == len(set(nt_tickers)), "Duplicate tickers in no_trade_decisions!"
assert set(dec_tickers).isdisjoint(set(nt_tickers)), "Overlap between decisions and no_trade_decisions!"

# Check coverage of prev_tickers
covered_prev = (set(dec_tickers) & prev_tickers) | set(nt_tickers)
assert covered_prev == prev_tickers, f"Missing or extra prev tickers: {prev_tickers ^ covered_prev}"
assert set(nt_tickers).issubset(prev_tickers), "no_trade_decisions has non-holding ticker!"

# Check BUY vs existing
dec_by_id = {d["decision_id"]: d for d in decisions}
for d in decisions:
    t = d["ticker"]
    act = d["action"]
    tw = d["target_weight"]
    assert len(d["inference_refs"]) >= 1
    for r in d["inference_refs"]:
        assert r in valid_inf_ids
        assert inferences[r][0] == t, f"Ref {r} ticker mismatch for {t}"
    assert len(d["risk_check"]) <= 300
    if act == "BUY":
        assert t not in prev_tickers
        assert 0 < tw <= 0.10
        assert d["funding_for"] is None
    elif act == "ADD":
        assert t in prev_tickers
        assert tw > holdings[t]["tradable_weight"]
        assert tw <= (0.25 if t == "2330" else 0.10)
        assert d["funding_for"] is None
    elif act == "TRIM":
        assert t in prev_tickers
        assert 0 < tw < holdings[t]["tradable_weight"]
        assert tw <= (0.25 if t == "2330" else 0.10)
    elif act == "SELL_ALL":
        assert t in prev_tickers
        assert tw == 0.0
    if d["funding_for"] is not None:
        assert act in ["TRIM", "SELL_ALL"]
        for fid in d["funding_for"]:
            assert fid in dec_by_id
            assert dec_by_id[fid]["action"] in ["BUY", "ADD"]

for nt in no_trade_decisions:
    t = nt["ticker"]
    assert len(nt["reason_refs"]) >= 1
    for r in nt["reason_refs"]:
        assert r in valid_inf_ids
        assert inferences[r][0] == t
    assert len(nt["reason"]) <= 300

# Final holdings count
final_count = sum(1 for d in decisions if d["target_weight"] > 0) + len(no_trade_decisions)
assert 20 <= final_count <= 30, f"Invalid holdings count: {final_count}"

# Final weight sum
final_weight_sum = sum(d["target_weight"] for d in decisions) + sum(holdings[nt["ticker"]]["tradable_weight"] for nt in no_trade_decisions)
est_cash = 1.0 - final_weight_sum
assert 0.15 <= est_cash <= 0.20, f"Cash {est_cash} out of [0.15, 0.20]"
assert est_cash <= 0.22
